mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals monetary easing, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as it signals labor market strengthening.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE falls below 4.0% in the next month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in demand (GDPC1) and decline in monetary policy tightness (FEDFUNDS) signals economic expansion, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises 5% and FEDFUNDS falls 1% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 rising and FEDFUNDS falling as described.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) amplifies S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days by easing financial conditions.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, 20-day returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS declines.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in monthly payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 145,000 triggers positive 5-day S&P 500 forward returns as it indicates labor market strength.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when PAYEMS crosses above 145,000.

mechanism_narrative: Contraction in demand (GDPC1 falls) alongside expansion in supply (INDPRO rises) signals economic slowdown, leading to negative 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 falls 3% and INDPRO rises 2% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite GDPC1 falling and INDPRO rising as described.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery, a drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5.0% triggers positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns as it signals labor market recovery.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE falls below 5.0% in post-recession recovery.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained high payroll employment (PAYEMS above 145,000 for three months) consistently triggers positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns as it reflects robust labor demand.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when PAYEMS remains above 145,000 for three consecutive months.
